messages:
Maria (CSM): Quick heads-up — Nimbus private deployment cutover scheduled tomorrow 02:00-03:00 UTC. Need final go/no-go on networking ACLs, IAM audit role trust, and KMS HSM policy. Customer expects zero data-plane downtime.
Alex (Eng-Infra): Thanks — checking runbook. One ask: are we sending S3/ES audit logs via an in-VPC forwarder or straight to their SIEM over a peered endpoint? This affects firewall ports.
Tom (Cloud Infra): We plan to deploy a log-forwarder in their VPC that ships to their collector via private link + VPC endpoint peering. So only egress to collector CIDR 10.23.45.0/24 on 443. @Kevin can you confirm this can be allowed during the window?
Kevin (Network): Staging rule already in place. I'll mirror to prod in-window once signoffs are collected. Rule: allow tcp/443 to 10.23.45.0/24 from subnet-xyz.
Rachel (Customer): Security requires KMS CMKs to be HSM-backed and wants auditable rotation evidence. Also they need the key policy for legal review before go-live.
Alex (Eng-Infra): We tested HSM CMKs in the private package. Rotation can be automated; we can also do an explicit rotation during cutover. Draft key policy uploaded: https://redwood.corp/drive/nimbus-kms-policy — please review.
Maria (CSM): I'll escalate legal/security for sign-off. If key policy isn't signed 48h before cutover, this becomes a schedule risk and may delay cutover — flagging as renewal-risk.
Tom (Cloud Infra): We also need the customer's IAM audit role trust so our observability account can assume arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/NimbusAudit. Sample trust policy posted below for their IAM team to import.
```
{ "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [{ "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::555555555555:role/RedwoodObservability"}, "Action": "sts:AssumeRole" }] }
```
Kevin (Network): Note: customer proxy uses mTLS. We need cert thumbprint to add to peering ACL. Who provides that?
Rachel (Customer): I'll DM the cert thumbprint today. Also SOC asked whether audit retention will be 90 or 180 days — they prefer 180.
Alex (Eng-Infra): We can set audit indices to 180 days but that bumps logs storage estimated +12% on their bill. Adding that to cutover notes.
Maria (CSM): Actions: 1) Rachel to share cert thumbprint today. 2) Customer to sign key policy by T-48h. 3) Kevin to apply prod egress rule in-window. 4) Alex/Tom to run staging canary 1h before cutover and validate forwarding. 5) DeployBot to run an incremental dry-run.
DeployBot: Canary queued: commit abc123 -> staging cluster 3. Link: https://deploys.redwood/canary/abc123
Alex (Eng-Infra): Rollback plan: if forwarder fails, revert network change and switch to host-side retention (local S3 snapshot). See runbook step 7.
Maria (CSM): Customer wants a short SOC-facing runbook. I'll extract 6 bullet steps and post by EOD.
Tom (Cloud Infra): Staffing for window: 1x infra, 1x network, 1x CSM, SRE standby. Confirm availability?
Kevin (Network): I'll be on network.
Alex (Eng-Infra): I'll run canary and monitor runtime.
Rachel (Customer): SOC on-call confirmed; legal still reviewing key policy (one clause edit). I'll expedite. Blockers: key policy and cert thumbprint until resolved.
Maria (CSM): If key policy signature and cert thumbprint aren't in by 20:00 UTC tonight, recommend delaying cutover 24h. Please surface blockers asap. :warning: :thumbsup:
DeployBot: Canary started at 3332108920 -> logs: https://logs.redwood/canary/abc123 (sample events present).
Alex (Eng-Infra): Canary shows 3 sample events forwarded successfully. @Rachel can your SOC confirm?
Rachel (Customer): SOC confirmed receipt. Cert thumbprint DM'd. Legal has a small edit; signing in progress.
Maria (CSM): Good progress — I'll post the SOC runbook clip in 30m and reconvene 2h prior to window for final checks.
